name: sing-box
blurb: sing-box is a fast, customizable and univsersal proxy platform that can be used to create network proxy servers, clients and transparent proxies.
description: sing-box is a fast, customizable and univsersal proxy platform that can be used to create network proxy servers, clients and transparent proxies. This app allows users to manage and use local and remote sing-box profiles and provides platform specific feature implementations such as the TUN transparent proxy implementation through the Android VpnService.
